The customer selects one of their previously saved addresses. The address details are snapshot-copied to the order at creation time, ensuring the historical shipping information remains accurate even if the customer later modifies or deletes the address.
addressId.x-autobe-specification: References e_commerce_mall_customer_addresses.id. At order creation, the system fetches the address by this ID (verified to belong to the authenticated customer and not soft-deleted), then snapshot-copies recipient_name, phone, street_address, city, state_province, postal_code, and country into the order's shipping_* fields.

IECommerceMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Selection of the shipping address to use when placing a new order.

The customer picks one of their saved shipping addresses by its unique identifier. All items currently in the customer's shopping cart will be implicitly included as the items to purchase. The cart must contain at least one available item with sufficient stock for the order to be placed.

The selected address's details (recipient name, phone, street address, city, state/province, postal code, country) are snapshot-copied to the order at creation time, ensuring historical accuracy even if the customer later modifies or deletes the address.
IECommerceMallOrder.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: The customer picks their saved shipping address by addressId (references e_commerce_mall_customer_addresses.id). All other order fields are system-managed: order code is auto-generated, total_price is calculated by summing cart item subtotals, shipping address fields are snapshot-copied from the selected address record, e_commerce_mall_customer_id comes from JWT, timestamps are auto-set, orderItems are created from cart items, and reviews are unrelated to creation.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

Defines which page of results to return, with page numbering starting from 1 (the first page). When not specified, defaults to 1 to return the first page of results. Combined with the {@link limit} parameter to control the window of records returned.
page.x-autobe-specification: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Combined with limit to calculate SQL OFFSET: (page - 1) * limit. Defaults to 1 when not provided.

limit.description:
Maximum number of items per page.

Controls how many wishlist items are returned in a single response. The maximum allowed value is 100, and values exceeding this cap are clamped down. When not specified, a system-defined default limit is applied. Higher values return more items per page at the cost of increased response size and latency.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records per page (1-100). Used in SQL LIMIT clause. Defaults to system-defined value when not provided.

search.description:
Keyword to filter wishlist items by the saved product's name.

Performs a partial match search against the product's name, allowing customers to find specific products in their wishlist. Only wishlist items whose referenced product name contains the search keyword (case-insensitive) are returned. When omitted, all wishlist items belonging to the authenticated customer are returned without name-based filtering.
search.x-autobe-specification: Optional keyword filter. Performs a partial match (LIKE '%keyword%') against e_commerce_mall_products.name via JOIN. When omitted, no name-based filtering is applied — all wishlist items for the customer are returned.

IECommerceMallWishlistItem.IRequest.description:
Pagination and search parameters for listing the authenticated customer's wishlist items.

The wishlist is automatically scoped to the customer who owns it, so no customer identifier is required in the request body. Results are ordered by addition date with the newest items appearing first.

Supported parameters include pagination controls ({@link page}, {@link limit}) and an optional {@link search} keyword to filter wishlist items by the saved product's name.
IECommerceMallWishlistItem.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for paginating the customer's wishlist. page/limit control pagination offset. search performs a LIKE query against the joined e_commerce_mall_products.name. All wishlist items are implicitly scoped to the authenticated customer's ID extracted from JWT. Results are ordered by e_commerce_mall_wishlist_items.created_at descending (newest first) — no alternate sort options are available.

id.description:
The unique identifier for the category.

Assigned automatically by the system when the category is created by an administrator. Used as the primary key for all category-related operations including retrieval, updates, and product assignment.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_categories.id. UUID primary key, auto-generated by the database.

name.description:
The display name of the category.

A short descriptive label such as "Electronics" or "Clothing" that identifies the category for customers browsing the product catalog. Must clearly convey what types of products belong here.

description.description:
A textual explanation of the category's scope.

Helps customers understand what types of products belong in this category when navigating the catalog hierarchy.

parent.description:
The parent category in the two-level hierarchy.

When non-null, this category is a subcategory belonging to the referenced parent (e.g., "Smartphones" under "Electronics"). When null, this category is a top-level category. Only one level of nesting is supported — subcategories cannot have further subcategories.
parent.x-autobe-specification: Self-join on e_commerce_mall_categories.parent_id referencing the same table's id. Null for top-level categories. Only one level of nesting is supported — a subcategory cannot itself be a parent to further subcategories.

subcategories.description:
Child categories belonging to this top-level parent.

Contains the direct subcategories organized under this parent. Empty array for leaf subcategories and for top-level categories that have no children assigned.
subcategories.x-autobe-specification: Self-join where parent_id = id on e_commerce_mall_categories filtered by deleted_at IS NULL. Empty array for leaf subcategories and for top-level categories with no children.

products_count.description:
The number of active (non-deleted) products assigned to this category.

Provides quick context on the quantity of products available within this category for browsing.
products_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed via COUNT on e_commerce_mall_products where category_id = this.id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Aggregation query, not a stored column.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the category was first created by an administrator.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_categories.created_at.

updated_at.description:
The timestamp when the category was last modified.

Updated whenever name, description, or parent relationship is changed by an administrator.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_categories.updated_at.

deleted_at.description:
The timestamp when the category was soft-deleted.

When present, the category has been deleted by an administrator. Soft deletion preserves referential integrity with existing product references and snapshot records. Products assigned to a deleted category become uncategorized.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_categories.deleted_at. Null when the category is active. Non-null indicates soft-deletion.

IECommerceMallCategory.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a product category for hierarchical listing and browsing on the e-commerce platform.

Each summary includes the category's identifying information (name, description) and its position in the hierarchy — a nullable parent reference for subcategories and a subcategories array for top-level categories. The products_count provides quick context on the number of active products assigned to this category.

Timestamps track the category lifecycle: creation, last modification, and soft-deletion.
IECommerceMallCategory.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct fields from e_commerce_mall_categories table. Parent via self-join on parent_id referencing the same table's id. Subcategories via self-join where parent_id = id (empty array for leaf subcategories). Products_count via COUNT on e_commerce_mall_products where category_id = id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Timestamps from DB columns. Soft-delete: deleted_at IS NULL filters out deleted categories.

sku_code.description:
Globally unique SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code identifying this variant across the entire platform.

Changing the SKU code triggers uniqueness validation against all other variants. The SKU code is required and must be unique across the platform — duplicates are rejected at the database level via a unique index.
sku_code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.sku_code. Uniqueness validated globally across all variants before update — query the table to ensure no other variant (excluding current) has the same SKU code.

price.description:
Optional price override for this variant, used instead of the parent product's base price.

When set to null, the variant inherits the product's base price. This allows variants with different pricing (e.g., a larger size costing more) while maintaining a base price for the product.
price.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.price. Nullable Float — when null, variant inherits parent product's base_price.

options.description:
Key-value pairs defining this variant's distinguishing attributes (e.g., color: "Red", size: "Large").

Option value combinations must remain unique within the parent product — no two variants of the same product can share identical option key-value pairs. Removed options are deleted, new ones are created, and existing ones are updated. Option values must not be empty and must have both key and value set.
options.x-autobe-specification: Composition mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL). Each option is IECommerceMallProductVariantOption with key-value pair. Delete removed options by key; create/update new ones. Each option must have a unique (variant_id, key) pair.

IECommerceMallProductVariant.IUpdate.description:
Update an existing product variant's SKU code, optional price override, and option key-value pairs.

This payload is used to modify a product variant's configuration. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated. The SKU code must remain globally unique across all variants on the platform. Setting price to null causes the variant to inherit the parent product's base price. The options array defines the distinguishing attribute pairs (e.g., color: "Red", size: "Large") that differentiate this variant from others of the same product.
IECommerceMallProductVariant.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping: sku_code from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.sku_code (unique globally). Direct mapping: price from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.price (nullable Float). Composition: options from e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) — each option is IECommerceMallProductVariantOption with key-value pair; delete removed by key, create/update new ones. Excluded: id (auto-generated UUID), e_commerce_mall_product_id (path parameter productId), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system-managed timestamps), product (belongs-to relation implicit from path), inventoryRecords (separate domain), options (has-many relation — DTO uses composition), cartItems (separate domain), orderItems (separate domain).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the product snapshot record.

Used as the primary key for referencing individual snapshots when retrieving full snapshot details or snapshot-specific variant and image records.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.id. UUID primary key.

name.description:
The product name as it appeared at the moment the snapshot was taken.

This is a preserved copy of the product's name, ensuring historical accuracy even if the product name is later changed or the product is deleted by the seller or an administrator.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.name. Denormalized copy of the product name at snapshot time.

base_price.description:
The product base price as it appeared at the moment the snapshot was taken.

This is a preserved copy of the product's base price, ensuring historical pricing records are available for financial auditing, dispute resolution, and order-related reference.
base_price.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.base_price. Double precision float.

product.description:
The parent product that this snapshot captures the state of.

Links the snapshot to its source product record. A product may have many snapshots over its lifetime, each triggered by a seller edit. This reference enables navigation from a historical snapshot back to the current product listing.
product.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.e_commerce_mall_product_id to e_commerce_mall_products.id. Returns IECommerceMallProduct.ISummary.

category.description:
The category that the product belonged to at the time the snapshot was taken.

May be null if the category was later deleted by an administrator. The snapshot preserves the category assignment as it existed at capture time for historical accuracy, even if the category no longer exists in the current system.
category.x-autobe-specification: LEFT JOIN from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.e_commerce_mall_category_id to e_commerce_mall_categories.id. Returns IECommerceMallCategory.ISummary or null.

variants_count.description:
Number of variant records captured in this product snapshot.

Represents how many product variant configurations (SKUs, prices, option values) existed for the product at the time the snapshot was taken. A value of 0 is valid and indicates the product had no variants at that point.
variants_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(e_commerce_mall_product_snapshot_variants) grouped by snapshot ID. Aggregation query.

images_count.description:
Number of product images captured in this product snapshot.

Represents how many images were associated with the product at the time the snapshot was taken. A value of 0 is valid and indicates the product had no images at that point.
images_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(e_commerce_mall_product_snapshot_images) grouped by snapshot ID. Aggregation query.

created_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when this product snapshot was created.

This serves as the chronological reference point and corresponds to the exact moment the product edit was saved. Snapshots are ordered by this timestamp when browsing historical versions (newest first). As snapshots are immutable, this timestamp is never updated.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots.created_at. Immutable timestamp.

IECommerceMallProductSnapshot.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a product snapshot for list display.

Each snapshot is an immutable historical record capturing the complete product state — name, description, base price, category assignment, variants, and images — at the moment a seller edited the product. This summary includes the preserved product name, historical base price, the parent product reference, the category assignment at capture time (if any), creation timestamp, and counts of associated variant and image snapshots.

The full description text is excluded from the summary view and available through the dedicated snapshot detail endpoint. Similarly, the individual variant and image snapshot records are not included — only their counts are provided for list display context.
IECommerceMallProductSnapshot.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct fields from e_commerce_mall_product_snapshots: id, name, base_price, description (excluded from ISummary), created_at. BELONGS-TO relations: product via JOIN to e_commerce_mall_products (non-nullable FK e_commerce_mall_product_id, returns IECommerceMallProduct.ISummary), category via LEFT JOIN to e_commerce_mall_categories (nullable FK e_commerce_mall_category_id, returns IECommerceMallCategory.ISummary or null when admin deletes category). Aggregations: variants_count via COUNT(e_commerce_mall_product_snapshot_variants) grouped by snapshot id, images_count via COUNT(e_commerce_mall_product_snapshot_images) grouped by snapshot id. Order by created_at DESC.

page.description:
Current page number for paginated results.

Page numbering starts from 1 (the first page). When not specified, defaults to 1. This parameter controls which slice of the ordered result set is returned, enabling clients to navigate through large collections of status log entries efficiently.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination: current page number (1-indexed). skip = (page - 1) * limit. Defaults to 1 when not provided.

limit.description:
Maximum number of status log entries to return per page.

Defines the page size constraint for paginated responses. The actual number of entries in the response may be lower on the final page or when total records are fewer than the limit. The maximum allowed value is 100, preventing excessively large page sizes.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination: maximum number of entries per page. take = limit. Maximum allowed value is 100. Defaults to a system-configured value (e.g., 20) when not provided.

to_status.description:
Filter by the new status of the order item transition.

Returns only log entries where the to_status matches the specified value. Valid status values include: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded. This filter enables users to quickly find all entries where an order item entered a particular state in its lifecycle.
to_status.x-autobe-specification: Filter using exact match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.to_status. Valid enum values: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded.

from_status.description:
Filter by the previous status before the transition.

Returns only log entries where the from_status matches the specified value. When filtering by null, returns entries where from_status is null — representing the initial 'paid' status entry that has no prior state. This filter allows tracing the origins of specific status transitions.
from_status.x-autobe-specification: Filter using exact match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.from_status. Handles null semantics correctly — null from_status represents the initial 'paid' status entry with no prior state.

reason.description:
Filter by the reason text associated with the status change.

Returns only log entries whose reason field contains the specified text (partial match). Common reason values include: shipment_created (item shipped), customer_delivery_confirmation (manual delivery confirmation), auto_delivery_timeout (14-day auto-delivery), cancellation_approved (seller approved cancellation), refund_approved (seller approved refund), administrator_force_cancel, and administrator_force_refund.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Filter using LIKE/substring match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.reason. Partial match against the reason text. Common values: shipment_created, customer_delivery_confirmation, auto_delivery_timeout, cancellation_approved, refund_approved, administrator_force_cancel, administrator_force_refund.

created_at_from.description:
Start of the date range for filtering by status log creation timestamp.

Returns only log entries created at or after this timestamp. When paired with created_at_to, defines a time window for retrieving status changes that occurred within a specific period. The 'shipped' status entry's created_at is the reference point for calculating the 14-day auto-delivery window.
created_at_from.x-autobe-specification: Filter: e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.created_at >= created_at_from. Date range lower bound — defines the start of the time window for filtering status changes.

created_at_to.description:
End of the date range for filtering by status log creation timestamp.

Returns only log entries created at or before this timestamp. When paired with created_at_from, defines a time window for retrieving status changes that occurred within a specific period.
created_at_to.x-autobe-specification: Filter: e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.created_at <= created_at_to. Date range upper bound — defines the end of the time window for filtering status changes.

IECommerceMallOrderItemStatusLog.IReques.description:
Request parameters for retrieving and filtering the status change history of a specific order item.

Returns a paginated, chronological list of all status transitions that have occurred for the given order item, providing a complete audit trail of its lifecycle from initial payment through shipping, delivery, and any cancellations or refunds.

Supports pagination through page and limit parameters, and optional filtering by the new status (to_status), previous status (from_status), reason text (partial match), and creation date range (created_at_from, created_at_to). All filter parameters are optional — omitting them returns the complete status history sorted by newest first.

The 'shipped' status entry's created_at timestamp is the reference point for the 14-day auto-delivery window. Each log entry records the from_status (previous state), to_status (new state), reason for the change, and precise timestamp, enabling full audit transparency for customer inquiries, seller operations, and administrator oversight.
IECommerceMallOrderItemStatusLog.IReques.x-autobe-specification:
Query the e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs table filtered by e_commerce_mall_order_item_id (from path param {itemId}). All filter parameters are optional — omitting all filters returns the complete status history for the order item sorted by created_at descending (newest first).

Filters:
- to_status: exact match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.to_status (enum: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded)
- from_status: exact match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.from_status (handles null correctly for initial 'paid' entries)
- reason: LIKE/substring match on e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.reason
- created_at_from: range filter — e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.created_at >= created_at_from
- created_at_to: range filter — e_commerce_mall_order_item_status_logs.created_at <= created_at_to

Pagination: page (1-indexed, skip = (page - 1) * limit), limit (page size, max 100, defaults to system-configured value like 20).

Validation: Verify parent order item exists in e_commerce_mall_order_items. Return 404 if not found.

sku_code.description:
Globally unique SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code identifying this variant across the entire platform.

This code must be unique across all products and variants. Duplicate SKU codes are rejected by the system with a conflict error. SKU codes are typically alphanumeric identifiers used for inventory tracking and order fulfillment purposes.
sku_code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.sku_code. Globally unique via @@unique constraint — duplicates are rejected at database level with a conflict error.

price.description:
Optional price override for this variant.

When set, this price is used instead of the parent product's base price. When null (the default), the variant automatically inherits the product's base price. This allows variants with different pricing (e.g., a larger size costing more) while maintaining a single base price for the parent product.
price.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_product_variants.price (Float?, nullable in DB). When null, the variant inherits the parent product's base_price during business logic.

options.description:
Option key-value pairs defining this variant's configuration dimensions.

Each variant must have at least one option to distinguish it from other variants of the same product. The system enforces that no two variants of the same product share identical option value combinations. Options define the distinguishing attributes that make this variant unique, such as color, size, material, or any other dimension relevant to the product. For example, a t-shirt product might have variants with options like color: 'Red' and size: 'Large'.
options.x-autobe-specification: Composition mapping: each option item in the array creates an e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options record with key and value fields, linked to the new variant ID via foreign key. At least one option is required per variant. The system enforces that no two variants of the same product share identical option value combinations.

IECommerceMallProductVariant.ICreate.description:
Creation request for a new product variant (SKU) under an existing product.

The authenticated seller creates a new configuration of their product by providing a globally unique SKU code, an optional price override (if not set, the variant inherits the parent product's base price), and option key-value pairs (e.g., color: 'Red', size: 'Large') that define this variant's distinguishing attributes.

The newly created variant starts with zero stock — the seller must separately restock inventory via the inventory management endpoint before the variant becomes available for purchase.
IECommerceMallProductVariant.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps sku_code (String, unique) and price (Float?, nullable) directly from e_commerce_mall_product_variants columns. Options is a composition: each option item creates an e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options record with key and value, linked to the new variant ID via foreign key. Excluded fields: id (auto UUID), e_commerce_mall_product_id (from URL path param), product (implicit from URL path), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (auto timestamps), inventoryRecords (separate endpoint), cartItems (separate endpoint), orderItems (separate endpoint).

id.description:
Unique identifier (UUID) for the product.

Assigned automatically at creation time and used as the primary reference for all product-related operations across the platform.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.id. UUID primary key, auto-generated at creation.

name.description:
Product display name shown in search results, category listings, and on the product detail page.

This is the primary identifier visible to customers when browsing the catalog and is used for full-text search across the platform.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.name. Indexed with GIN trigram operator for full-text search.

description.description:
Detailed textual description of the product shown on the product detail page.

Provides customers with information about features, specifications, usage instructions, and other relevant details to inform their purchasing decision.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.description. Stored as TEXT in database.

base_price.description:
Base price of the product in the platform's currency.

Serves as the default price displayed on listing pages such as search results and category pages. When variants have price overrides, the listing page may display a price range. Individual variants can override this price through their own price field.
base_price.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.base_price. Stored as DoublePrecision in database.

visibility.description:
Current visibility state controlling the product's appearance in search results and category listings.

Valid values: 'visible' (default, appears normally in all listings), 'unavailable_but_visible' (no variants exist, shown as unavailable for purchase but still visible), 'deleted' (soft-deleted by seller or administrator, hidden from all customer-facing listings), 'suspended' (seller account suspended by administrator, hidden from listings and cannot be purchased until suspension is lifted).
visibility.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.visibility. Valid enum values: 'visible', 'unavailable_but_visible', 'deleted', 'suspended'.

seller.description:
The seller who owns this product.

Includes the seller's unique identifier, email, approval status, and public shop profile (shop name and logo image). Each product belongs to exactly one seller.
seller.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: JOIN e_commerce_mall_products.seller_id to e_commerce_mall_sellers.id. Returns IECommerceMallSeller.ISummary which includes profile (shop_name, logo_image from e_commerce_mall_seller_profiles).

category.description:
The product category assigned to this product for catalog organization.

May be null if the category was deleted by an administrator. Products without a category remain visible in search results but are not associated with any category listing page.
category.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation via LEFT JOIN: e_commerce_mall_products.category_id to e_commerce_mall_categories.id. Returns IECommerceMallCategory.ISummary. Nullable — when an administrator soft-deletes a category, category_id is set to null and this field becomes null.

images.description:
All uploaded product images sorted by display order (ascending sort_order).

The image with the lowest sort_order (typically 0) serves as the main thumbnail displayed in search results, category listings, and wishlist views. All images are displayed on the product detail page in ascending sort_order order.
images.x-autobe-specification: HAS-MANY composition from e_commerce_mall_product_images table: query WHERE e_commerce_mall_product_id = product.id AND deleted_at IS NULL, sorted by sort_order ASC. Returns IECommerceMallProductImage[] with id, url, sort_order, product (IECommerceMallProduct.ISummary), created_at, updated_at. The first image (lowest sort_order, typically 0) serves as the thumbnail.

variants.description:
All active (non-deleted) product variants available for purchase.

Each variant represents a specific purchasable configuration identified by a globally unique SKU code, with option key-value pairs (e.g., color: 'Red', size: 'Large'), an optional price override, and the current stock quantity computed from inventory history records.
variants.x-autobe-specification: HAS-MANY composition from e_commerce_mall_product_variants table: query WHERE e_commerce_mall_product_id = product.id AND deleted_at IS NULL, sorted by created_at ASC. Returns IECommerceMallProductVariant[]. Each variant includes: options from e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL, key-value pairs like color:'Red'), stock computed as SUM(e_commerce_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change) for that variant.

reviews.description:
All non-deleted customer reviews for this product, sorted by newest first.

Each review includes the customer's display name (anonymized to 'deleted user' if the author's account has been deleted), a star rating from 1 (lowest satisfaction) to 5 (highest satisfaction), optional text content describing the customer's experience, and timestamps. Reviews can only be written after the corresponding order item has been delivered.
reviews.x-autobe-specification: HAS-MANY composition from e_commerce_mall_reviews table: query WHERE e_commerce_mall_product_id = product.id AND deleted_at IS NULL, ordered by created_at DESC. Returns IECommerceMallReview[] with customer display_name (LEFT JOIN e_commerce_mall_customer_profiles, anonymized to 'deleted user' if customer account deleted), rating 1-5, content (nullable string), order and orderItem references, and timestamps.

average_rating.description:
The average star rating calculated from all non-deleted customer reviews.

Rounded to one decimal place. Null when no reviews exist for this product, allowing UI to display 'No reviews yet' instead of a misleading 0.0.
average_rating.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SELECT AVG(rating) FROM e_commerce_mall_reviews WHERE e_commerce_mall_product_id = product.id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Rounded to one decimal place. Returns null when no non-deleted reviews exist (e.g., product has no reviews yet).

review_count.description:
The total number of non-deleted customer reviews for this product.

Used alongside average_rating to provide context on the rating's statistical reliability. Returns 0 when no reviews exist.
review_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e_commerce_mall_reviews WHERE e_commerce_mall_product_id = product.id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns integer, 0 when no reviews exist.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this product was first created and listed on the platform.

Automatically set at creation time and used for sorting products by newest first in search results and category listings.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_products.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format (UTC). Set automatically at record creation.

updated_at.description:

IECommerceMallOrderItem.description:
Full detail of an order item, representing a purchased product variant line item within a customer order.

Each order item tracks the quantity purchased, the unit price captured at the time of purchase (immutable historical record), and its independent fulfillment status (paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded). Since different items in the same order can be fulfilled by different sellers, each item maintains its own status lifecycle.

The response includes historical snapshots preserving the product, variant, and seller profile state exactly as they existed when the order was placed — ensuring accurate audit trails and dispute resolution even if the seller later modifies or deletes the product. When the item has been shipped, tracking information from the parent shipment is included. The full status transition history is available through the status logs array.

Seller's response to a cancellation request, specifying whether the request is approved or rejected.

This DTO is the request body for the seller's decision on a pending cancellation request. The seller reviews the customer's cancellation reason and decides to either approve or reject the request.

When approving, only the {@link status} field needs to be set to `approved`. The system automatically handles the side effects: creating a snapshot, cancelling the order item, and restoring stock quantities.

When rejecting, set {@link status} to `rejected` and optionally provide a {@link rejection_reason} explaining why the cancellation was declined.

On approval, the system also creates a cancellation request snapshot, cancels the order item, and creates a positive inventory record via atomic transaction.

IECommerceMallRefundRequest.ICreate.description:
Creation request payload for initiating a refund on a specific delivered order item.

A customer submits this request to seek a refund for an individual order item that has been delivered. The customer must specify which order item to refund and provide a textual explanation of the reason.

The customer's identity is automatically resolved from the authenticated session, and the seller responsible for the item is derived from the order item's product variant ownership chain — neither needs to be provided in the request body.

The refund request is created with the following field handling:
- orderItemId: directly mapped to e_commerce_mall_order_item_id from user input.
- reason: directly mapped to reason column from user input.
- e_commerce_mall_customer_id: resolved from the authenticated customer's JWT session.
- e_commerce_mall_seller_id: derived by joining orderItem → productVariant → product → seller chain.
- status: automatically set to 'pending' on creation.
- response_timestamp: set to null on creation.
- id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at: auto-generated/managed by the system.

2. The order item's status must be 'delivered'.
3. The request must be within 7 calendar days of delivery.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the refund request snapshot.

The snapshot ID identifies a specific historical record within a refund request's audit trail. Use this ID to retrieve the full snapshot details via the dedicated snapshot retrieval endpoint. The parent refund request is inferred from the path parameter.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.id.

reason.description:
The refund reason provided by the customer, preserved as it existed when the seller responded.

This field is intentionally denormalized to capture the customer's stated reason at the exact moment the snapshot was created. Because snapshots are immutable, this provides an authoritative historical record for audit and dispute resolution, even if the customer later changes their story or the parent refund request is updated.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.reason. Denormalized from the parent refund request at the time of snapshot creation for immutable audit trail.

status.description:
The seller's decision captured in this snapshot.

Indicates whether the refund request was approved or rejected by the seller. An approved status means the refund has been processed, resulting in a financial reversal and automatic stock restoration via a positive inventory record on the associated product variant. A rejected status means the refund was denied and the item remains in its delivered state.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.status. One of 'approved' or 'rejected'. This is a terminal status — once set, it cannot be changed.

response_timestamp.description:
The date and time when the seller responded to the refund request.

This timestamp is captured at the moment the seller makes a decision and is preserved immutably in the snapshot. It provides an authoritative record of when the seller's decision was made, supporting audit requirements and dispute resolution workflows.
response_timestamp.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.response_timestamp. Immutable timestamp preserved at snapshot time.

created_at.description:
The date and time when this snapshot record was created.

Snapshots are append-only records that cannot be modified or deleted after creation. This timestamp establishes the creation order of snapshots within a refund request's history and helps determine the sequence of events during audits.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.created_at.

IECommerceMallRefundRequestSnapshot.ISum.description:
Summary record of a refund request snapshot for list display.

Each snapshot is an immutable audit record automatically created when a seller responds to a refund request — either approving or rejecting it. The summary captures the customer's stated reason, the seller's decision, and the timestamp of the response.

Results are listed in the context of a specific parent refund request, so the parent reference is omitted for clarity.
IECommerceMallRefundRequestSnapshot.ISum.x-autobe-specification: Summary fields directly from e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots table: id, reason, status, response_timestamp, created_at. Filtered by e_commerce_mall_refund_request_id matching path parameter. No relations included since parent refundRequest is implicit via path parameter context.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the review snapshot.

Auto-generated UUID primary key assigned when the snapshot is created.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_review_snapshots.id (UUID primary key).

review.description:
The parent review that this snapshot belongs to.

Each snapshot preserves the state of a single review at a specific point in time. This reference links back to the original review, including its rating, text content, customer author, and the associated product.
review.x-autobe-specification: Join via e_commerce_mall_review_id FK to e_commerce_mall_reviews. Returns IECommerceMallReview.ISummary.

rating.description:
The star rating value preserved in this snapshot (1–5).

Represents the review's rating at the moment the snapshot was captured. This is the previous rating value before an edit was applied, or the initial rating for the 'created' snapshot.
rating.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_review_snapshots.rating. Integer, range 1-5.

text.description:
The text content preserved in this snapshot.

Represents the review's free-text description at the moment the snapshot was captured. Nullable because text is optional in reviews — a review may have a rating without any accompanying text.
text.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_review_snapshots.text. Nullable — may be null when review had no text content at snapshot time.

changed_fields.description:
Indicates which fields were changed in the edit that triggered this snapshot.

Valid values include 'rating', 'text', 'rating_and_text', and 'created'. The 'created' value is used for the initial snapshot taken when a review is first written, while the other values describe which attribute(s) were modified in subsequent edits.

created_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when this snapshot was created.

Records the precise moment when the snapshot was captured, establishing a chronological reference point for the preserved review state. Snapshots are ordered by this timestamp to reconstruct the full edit history of a review.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_review_snapshots.created_at. DateTime with timezone.

IECommerceMallReviewSnapshot.description:
An immutable historical record preserving the state of a customer's product review at a specific point in time.

Snapshots are automatically created by the system whenever a customer edits their review, capturing the previous rating (1–5 stars) and text content before the edit is applied. An initial 'created' snapshot is also recorded when the review is first written.

Each snapshot includes the preserved rating value and optional text content, a changed_fields indicator describing which attributes were modified in the edit that triggered the snapshot, and a timestamp of when the snapshot was captured.

Snapshots are immutable and retained indefinitely — even after the original review is deleted by its author.
IECommerceMallReviewSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Direct column mapping from e_commerce_mall_review_snapshots table. BELONGS-TO relation to e_commerce_mall_reviews transformed to $ref via IECommerceMallReview.ISummary. Nullable text field uses oneOf for JSON Schema compliance. The FK column e_commerce_mall_review_id is excluded from the DTO as it is exposed via the review relation object.

IECommerceMallShipment.description:
Complete shipment record representing a physical package dispatched by a seller to fulfill customer order items.

A shipment groups one or more order items from the same seller into a single package with a shared carrier name, tracking number, and shipped timestamp. Each shipment belongs to a seller who created it, and contains shipment items that link to the bundled order items.

The {@link deliveredAt} field records when the customer confirmed delivery; it remains `null` while the package is in transit. The {@link seller} provides the shop identity responsible for this shipment, and {@link shipmentItems} enumerates the specific order items packed together in this package.
IECommerceMallShipment.x-autobe-specification: Direct columns: id, carrier_name, tracking_number, shipped_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. BELONGS-TO: seller via JOIN with e_commerce_mall_sellers (as ISummary: id, email, approval_status). HAS-MANY: shipmentItems via JOIN with e_commerce_mall_shipment_items (as IECommerceMallShipmentItem array). No aggregation (*_count) fields for this entity.

rating.description:
Updated star rating from 1 (lowest satisfaction) to 5 (highest satisfaction).

Provide this field only if you wish to change the existing rating. The value must be a whole number between 1 and 5 inclusive.
rating.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_reviews.rating. Must be an integer between 1 and 5. Required when provided in the request body.

content.description:
Updated free-text description providing detailed feedback about the product.

Provide this field only if you wish to change the existing text content. Set to `null` to clear the existing text content while preserving the review record.
content.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_reviews.content. Setting to null clears the existing text content while preserving the review record.

IECommerceMallReview.IUpdate.description:
Update payload for modifying a review's rating and/or text content.

Both fields are optional — provide only the fields you wish to change. Setting content to `null` clears the existing text content while preserving the review record. Before applying the update, the system creates an immutable snapshot of the current review state to preserve the edit history.

Soft-deleted reviews cannot be edited.
IECommerceMallReview.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification:
Mutable fields mapped from e_commerce_mall_reviews: rating (Int, 1-5), content (String?, nullable to clear).

Excluded fields:
- id (auto-generated UUID)
- e_commerce_mall_customer_id (resolved from JWT — authenticated customer actor identity)
- e_commerce_mall_product_id (immutable after creation, structural FK)
- e_commerce_mall_order_item_id (immutable after creation, structural FK)
- e_commerce_mall_order_id (immutable after creation, structural FK)
- created_at (auto-generated, preserved unchanged)
- updated_at (auto-managed on every update)
- deleted_at (not user-managed)

Excluded relations:
- customer (actor identity resolved from JWT)
- product (structural, immutable after creation)
- orderItem (structural, immutable after creation)
- order (structural, immutable after creation)
- snapshots (HAS-MANY composition, system-managed automatically on update)

id.description:
Unique identifier for this shipment-item association record.

The primary key of the shipment-item junction table, representing the unique link between a shipment and the order item packed within it. This identifier is used for referencing the association in subsequent operations.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_shipment_items.id. UUID primary key.

orderItem.description:
The order item packed within this shipment, with product details preserved from the time of purchase.

Includes the purchased product name, variant SKU and options, seller's shop name, quantity, unit price (captured at purchase time), calculated subtotal (quantity × unit_price), and the current fulfillment status (paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded). All product and seller details are sourced from immutable order-time snapshots, ensuring historical accuracy even if the product or seller profile is later modified.
orderItem.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: join e_commerce_mall_shipment_items.order_item_id to e_commerce_mall_order_items.id. Returns IECommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary with flattened snapshot data (product_name, variant_sku, variant_options, shop_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal, status).

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the order item was added to this shipment.

Indicates when the seller assigned this order item to the shipment package. For list views, items are typically sorted by this timestamp in descending order (newest first).
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_shipment_items.created_at, mapped to camelCase createdAt.

IECommerceMallShipmentItem.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a shipment-item association, representing an order item packed within a shipment package.

Each shipment item links a specific order item to a parent shipment. The summary includes the order item's product details, variant information, quantity, unit price, and current fulfillment status, all preserved from the time of purchase through immutable snapshots.
IECommerceMallShipmentItem.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct fields from e_commerce_mall_shipment_items: id, created_at (mapped to createdAt camelCase). BELONGS-TO: orderItem via $ref to IECommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary (FK order_item_id replaced by $ref). Excluded: shipment_id and shipment relation (path param context, not needed in summary view), updated_at (not essential for list display), order_item_id (replaced by $ref to orderItem).

id.description:
The unique identifier of the cart item.

This UUID is assigned by the system when the cart item is first created and does not change throughout the cart item's lifecycle.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.id. Primary key (UUID).

quantity.description:
The quantity of the product variant the customer intends to purchase.

Must be a positive integer. When a customer adds the same variant to an existing cart item, the quantities are combined by increasing the existing item's quantity by the newly requested quantity. If the quantity is set to zero during modification, the cart item is removed (soft-deleted).
quantity.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.quantity. Positive integer representing desired purchase quantity.

unit_price.description:
The unit price of the product variant for cart display.

If the variant has a non-null price override, that price is used; otherwise the parent product's base price is inherited. This computed value represents the effective price of a single unit of the variant.
unit_price.x-autobe-specification: Computed: unit_price = variant.price ?? product.base_price. If the variant has a non-null price override (e_commerce_mall_product_variants.price), that price is used; otherwise the parent product's base price (e_commerce_mall_products.base_price) is inherited. Not stored in the database — calculated at query time by joining the variant and its parent product.

subtotal.description:
The calculated subtotal for this cart item, computed as the unit price multiplied by the quantity.

This is a derived value shown for display purposes only and may differ from the final charged amount.
subtotal.x-autobe-specification: Computed: subtotal = unit_price * quantity. Calculated at query time from the computed unit_price and the cart item's quantity. Not stored in the database.

is_available.description:
Indicates whether the product variant is currently available for purchase.

A variant is marked as unavailable if it has been soft-deleted or its computed stock quantity is zero. Unavailable cart items are excluded from checkout.
is_available.x-autobe-specification: Computed: is_available = (variant.deleted_at IS NULL AND computed stock > 0). A variant is unavailable if it has been soft-deleted (e_commerce_mall_product_variants.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) or its computed stock quantity (SUM of e_commerce_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change) is zero or less. Not stored in the database.

customer.description:
The customer who owns this cart item.

Each cart item belongs to exactly one customer. The customer's identity is resolved from the authenticated session and used for ownership verification and display purposes.
customer.x-autobe-specification: Relation: LEFT JOIN e_commerce_mall_customers using e_commerce_mall_customer_id FK. Mapped as IECommerceMallCustomer.ISummary. The customer is the authenticated actor resolved from the JWT session context — used for ownership verification and display.

productVariant.description:
The product variant (SKU) selected for this cart item.

Each cart item references exactly one product variant. The variant provides full details including SKU code, option values (e.g., color, size), price override, computed stock quantity, and the parent product information.
productVariant.x-autobe-specification: Relation: JOIN e_commerce_mall_product_variants using e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id FK. Mapped as IECommerceMallProductVariant (full entity) which includes nested product info, variant options from e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options, and computed stock from SUM(e_commerce_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change).

created_at.description: The timestamp when this cart item was first created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.created_at. Set automatically on record creation.

updated_at.description:
The timestamp when this cart item was last modified.

Updated on any field change such as quantity updates.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.updated_at. Updated automatically on each modification such as quantity changes.

deleted_at.description:
The timestamp when this cart item was soft-deleted, if applicable.

When a customer removes a cart item, it is soft-deleted rather than physically deleted to preserve records. This field is null for active cart items and set to the current timestamp upon removal.

This property is null when the cart item is still active.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.deleted_at. Nullable DateTime. When set, the cart item is considered soft-deleted and excluded from active cart views.

IECommerceMallCartItem.description:
A cart item represents a customer's intent to purchase a specific quantity of a single product variant.

Each cart item belongs to exactly one customer and references exactly one product variant (SKU). The quantity must be a positive integer — if the same variant is added to the cart multiple times, the quantities are combined into a single cart item rather than creating duplicate entries.

The computed fields include the unit price (the variant's price override if set, otherwise the parent product's base price), subtotal (unit price multiplied by quantity), and availability status (whether the variant is active and in stock). The nested productVariant provides full variant details including SKU code, option values, price override, computed stock quantity, and the parent product information.
IECommerceMallCartItem.x-autobe-specification: Direct: id, quantity, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from e_commerce_mall_cart_items. Relations: customer via LEFT JOIN e_commerce_mall_customers (auth actor from JWT, mapped as IECommerceMallCustomer.ISummary), productVariant via JOIN e_commerce_mall_product_variants (full IECommerceMallProductVariant with nested product, variant options from e_commerce_mall_product_variant_options, computed stock from e_commerce_mall_inventory_records). Computed: unit_price (variant.price ?? product.base_price), subtotal (unit_price * quantity), is_available (variant.deleted_at IS NULL AND computed stock > 0). Filter: deleted_at IS NULL on read operations. Excluded FK columns: e_commerce_mall_customer_id (exposed as customer object), e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id (exposed as productVariant object).

carrierName.description:
Filter shipments by carrier company name.

Performs a case-insensitive partial text match against the carrier name field. For example, searching 'express' would match carriers containing 'express' in their name such as 'FedEx Express' or 'DHL Express'.
carrierName.x-autobe-specification: Partial/fuzzy text match against e_commerce_mall_shipments.carrier_name column. Case-insensitive string search using LIKE or similarity operator.

trackingNumber.description:
Filter shipments by tracking number.

Performs a case-insensitive partial text match against the tracking number field, allowing customers to locate a specific package by entering a portion of its tracking number.
trackingNumber.x-autobe-specification: Partial/fuzzy text match against e_commerce_mall_shipments.tracking_number column. Case-insensitive string search using LIKE or similarity operator.

shippedAtFrom.description:
Filter shipments dispatched on or after this timestamp.

Use together with shippedAtTo to define an inclusive date range for when the package was dispatched by the seller. Only shipments whose shipped timestamp falls on or after this value will be included. Provide a full ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z').
shippedAtFrom.x-autobe-specification: Inclusive lower bound date range filter applied to e_commerce_mall_shipments.shipped_at column (WHERE shipped_at >= shippedAtFrom). Used together with shippedAtTo to define an inclusive temporal range.

shippedAtTo.description:
Filter shipments dispatched on or before this timestamp.

Use together with shippedAtFrom to define an inclusive date range for when the package was dispatched by the seller. Only shipments whose shipped timestamp falls on or before this value will be included. Provide a full ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z').
shippedAtTo.x-autobe-specification: Inclusive upper bound date range filter applied to e_commerce_mall_shipments.shipped_at column (WHERE shipped_at <= shippedAtTo). Used together with shippedAtFrom to define an inclusive temporal range.

deliveredAtFrom.description:
Filter shipments delivered on or after this timestamp.

Use together with deliveredAtTo to define an inclusive date range for when the package was confirmed delivered. Only shipments with a confirmed delivery timestamp (delivered status) can match this filter. Provide a full ISO 8601 date-time string.
deliveredAtFrom.x-autobe-specification: Inclusive lower bound date range filter applied to e_commerce_mall_shipments.delivered_at column (WHERE delivered_at >= deliveredAtFrom). Only shipments with a non-null delivered_at (delivered status) can match this filter.

deliveredAtTo.description:
Filter shipments delivered on or before this timestamp.

Use together with deliveredAtFrom to define an inclusive date range for when the package was confirmed delivered. Only shipments with a confirmed delivery timestamp (delivered status) can match this filter. Provide a full ISO 8601 date-time string.
deliveredAtTo.x-autobe-specification: Inclusive upper bound date range filter applied to e_commerce_mall_shipments.delivered_at column (WHERE delivered_at <= deliveredAtTo). Only shipments with a non-null delivered_at (delivered status) can match this filter.

deliveryStatus.description:
Filter shipments by their current delivery state.

Select 'shipped' to view packages that are currently in transit and have not yet been confirmed as delivered. Select 'delivered' to view packages that have been confirmed received by the customer or auto-delivered after the 14-day window.
deliveryStatus.x-autobe-specification: Derived enum filter on e_commerce_mall_shipments: 'shipped' maps to delivered_at IS NULL (package in transit), 'delivered' maps to delivered_at IS NOT NULL (confirmed received). Only one value can be selected at a time.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results (1-indexed).

Use this parameter to navigate through pages of shipment results. The first page is page 1. Omit or set to 1 to retrieve the first page of results. Each page contains up to limit records. Page numbering starts from 1.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-based page index for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified. Used to navigate through paginated result sets. Must be >= 1.

limit.description:
Maximum number of shipment records to return per page.

Controls how many shipments are included in each page of results. The minimum value is 1 and the maximum allowed value is 100. The actual number of records returned may be less than this value on the final page or when total records are fewer.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records per page. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Defaults to a system-defined value if not specified. Actual returned count may be less on the last page or when fewer records exist.

sort.description:
Sort order for the result set.

Specify a field name to sort by, optionally prefixed with '-' for descending order. For example, 'shipped_at' sorts by shipment date ascending (oldest first), while '-shipped_at' sorts descending (newest first). Defaults to sorting by creation date descending (newest shipments first).
sort.x-autobe-specification: Sort field and direction directive. Format: 'fieldName' for ascending order or '-fieldName' for descending order. Default is '-created_at' (newest first). Supported sort fields: created_at, shipped_at, delivered_at, carrier_name, tracking_number.

IECommerceMallShipment.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and pagination request for listing shipments.

All fields are optional. When no filters are provided, the most recently created shipments accessible by the authenticated actor are returned, sorted by creation date descending (newest first). Filters are combined with AND logic.

Use carrierName and trackingNumber for text-based search against the carrier name and tracking number fields. Date range filters (shippedAtFrom, shippedAtTo, deliveredAtFrom, deliveredAtTo) allow temporal narrowing by shipment dispatch time and delivery confirmation time. The deliveryStatus filter lets you filter by delivery state: 'shipped' for packages in transit (not yet delivered) and 'delivered' for packages that have been confirmed received.

Pagination is controlled via page (1-indexed), limit (items per page, maximum 100), and sort (field name with optional '-' prefix for descending order). Access is automatically scoped by actor type through authentication — sellers see only their own shipments, customers see shipments tied to their orders, and administrators see all shipments across the platform.
IECommerceMallShipment.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Search/filter query for e_commerce_mall_shipments table with actor-based authorization scoping. carrierName: partial/fuzzy match on carrier_name column. trackingNumber: partial/fuzzy match on tracking_number column. shippedAtFrom/shippedAtTo: inclusive date range filter on shipped_at column. deliveredAtFrom/deliveredAtTo: inclusive date range filter on delivered_at column. deliveryStatus: derived enum — 'shipped' maps to delivered_at IS NULL, 'delivered' maps to delivered_at IS NOT NULL. sort: field name optionally prefixed with '-' for descending order; default to '-created_at'. page: 1-based index, default 1. limit: items per page, default system-defined, max 100. Soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) excluded by default; administrators may optionally include them.

id.description:
The unique identifier of the refund request.

This UUID is assigned at creation time and serves as the primary identifier for referencing the refund request across the platform, including in URL paths for retrieving or responding to individual requests.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.id. UUID primary key.

reason.description:
The textual explanation provided by the customer describing why they are requesting a refund.

This reason is captured when the refund request is submitted and is preserved permanently. It is visible to the seller reviewing the request and is included in the snapshot created when the seller responds, ensuring an immutable audit trail of the request's justification.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.reason. Text provided by the customer.

status.description:
The current status of the refund request, indicating where it stands in the review process.

Possible values are:
- `pending`: The refund request has been submitted and is awaiting a decision from the seller
- `approved`: The seller has approved the refund, triggering a financial reversal and stock restoration
- `rejected`: The seller has denied the refund request

Pending is the initial status upon creation. Approved and Rejected are terminal states — once reached, no further status changes occur.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.status. Possible values: pending, approved, rejected.

response_timestamp.description:
The timestamp of when the seller responded to the refund request by either approving or rejecting it.

This field remains null while the request is in `pending` status and is set at the moment the seller makes a decision. The value is preserved in the snapshot for audit purposes.
response_timestamp.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.response_timestamp. Nullable DateTime, null while pending.

orderItem.description:
The order item associated with this refund request, summarized for list display.

This is the delivered order item that the customer is seeking a refund for. The summary includes the product name, variant details, quantity, unit price, and current item status.
orderItem.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO join from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.e_commerce_mall_order_item_id to e_commerce_mall_order_items.id. Returns IECommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary.

customer.description:
The customer who submitted this refund request, summarized for list display.

Only the customer who purchased the order item can initiate a refund for it. The summary includes the customer's email and profile information.
customer.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO join from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.e_commerce_mall_customer_id to e_commerce_mall_customers.id. Returns IECommerceMallCustomer.ISummary.

seller.description:
The seller who owns the product variant in the refunded order item and must respond to the request.

The seller reviews the refund reason and decides whether to approve or reject the request. The summary includes the seller's shop name and email.
seller.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO join from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.e_commerce_mall_seller_id to e_commerce_mall_sellers.id. Returns IECommerceMallSeller.ISummary.

snapshots_count.description:
The number of immutable snapshots created for this refund request.

A snapshot is created when the seller responds to the refund request (approves or rejects). A count of 0 indicates the request is still pending. A count of 1 or more indicates the seller has responded and the request has been resolved.
snapshots_count.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation: COUNT of e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots WHERE refund_request_id = e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.id. 0 when no snapshots exist (still pending).

created_at.description:
The timestamp when the refund request was created by the customer.

Automatically set upon creation and used for sorting refund requests by submission date in list views.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.created_at.

updated_at.description:
The timestamp when the refund request was last modified.

Updated when the seller responds to the request, changing the status and setting the response timestamp.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.updated_at.

deleted_at.description:
The timestamp when the refund request was soft-deleted.

Null indicates the record is active. When set, the refund request is considered deleted but the record is preserved for audit and legal purposes.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests.deleted_at. Nullable.

IECommerceMallRefundRequest.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a refund request displayed in list views.

Each summary includes the refund reason provided by the customer, the current request status (pending, approved, or rejected), and the response timestamp if the seller has responded. The related order item, customer, and seller are referenced as summarized objects. An aggregation count of snapshots indicates whether the seller has responded to the request.

This summary is designed for administrator and seller list views where multiple refund requests are displayed in a paginated format. For full details including all snapshots and the complete state history, refer to the IECommerceMallRefundRequest detail type.
IECommerceMallRefundRequest.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct column mappings from e_commerce_mall_refund_requests: id, reason, status, response_timestamp (nullable), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (nullable). Relations: orderItem via JOIN on e_commerce_mall_order_item_id (BELONGS-TO, $ref IECommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary), customer via JOIN on e_commerce_mall_customer_id (BELONGS-TO, $ref IECommerceMallCustomer.ISummary), seller via JOIN on e_commerce_mall_seller_id (BELONGS-TO, $ref IECommerceMallSeller.ISummary). Aggregation: snapshots_count = COUNT of e_commerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots WHERE refund_request_id = id. Excluded FK columns: e_commerce_mall_order_item_id (exposed as orderItem relation), e_commerce_mall_customer_id (exposed as customer relation), e_commerce_mall_seller_id (exposed as seller relation). Excluded HAS-MANY: refundRequestSnapshots (exposed as snapshots_count aggregation, not the full composition).

IECommerceMallReviewSnapshot.IRequest.description:

{@link category} reflects the category assignment at capture time, which may be null if the category was later deleted by an administrator.

status.description:

- `approved`: The seller has approved the refund. This triggers a financial reversal and automatic stock restoration via a positive inventory record on the associated product variant.

IECommerceMallRefundRequest.description:
A refund request submitted by a customer for a specific delivered order item, awaiting or having received a seller decision.

Each refund request targets exactly one delivered order item within the 7-day refund window. The customer provides a textual reason explaining why they seek a refund, and the seller who owns the product variant must respond by either approving or rejecting the request.

When the seller responds, an immutable snapshot of the request state is created in IECommerceMallRefundRequestSnapshot for audit trail purposes. Approved requests trigger a financial reversal and automatic stock restoration via a positive inventory record on the associated product variant.

The refund request lifecycle tracks three key actors: the customer who submitted it (customer), the seller who must respond (seller), and the order item being contested (orderItem). The status field indicates where the request is — pending (awaiting seller response), approved (refund granted), or rejected (refund denied).

BELONGS-TO relations (FK columns excluded from DTO, replaced by $ref objects): orderItem joined via e_commerce_mall_order_item_id to e_commerce_mall_order_items as IECommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary, customer joined via e_commerce_mall_customer_id to e_commerce_mall_customers as IECommerceMallCustomer.ISummary, seller joined via e_commerce_mall_seller_id to e_commerce_mall_sellers as IECommerceMallSeller.ISummary. The parent {@link IECommerceMallProduct product} is included as a summary reference, providing the product name and base price context.

IECommerceMallReview.description:
A product review written by a customer after receiving a delivered order item.

Each review contains a star rating from 1 (lowest satisfaction) to 5 (highest satisfaction) and optional free-text content describing the customer's experience. The customer display name is automatically anonymized to 'deleted user' if the author's account has been deleted, preserving privacy while maintaining review content permanently visible on the product detail page.

Uses the variant's price override if set, otherwise falls back to the parent product's base price. When `true`, the customer should reduce the quantity to match the available stock before checkout. Only applicable when the item's availability is `"available"` — unavailable items are already excluded from checkout.
stock_warning.x-autobe-specification: Computed as boolean: true when quantity > available_stock, otherwise false. Only relevant when availability is 'available' — unavailable items are excluded from checkout regardless.

available_stock.description:
Current available stock quantity of the product variant.

Derived by summing all inventory quantity changes for this variant. Provides customers with visibility into how many units are actually in stock, allowing them to adjust their cart quantity accordingly before checkout.
available_stock.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COALESCE(SUM(e_commerce_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change), 0) for the product variant joined via e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id. Returns 0 when no inventory records exist for the variant.

variant.description:
The product variant selected for this cart item.

Provides access to variant details including SKU code, option values (e.g., color, size), effective price, stock status, and parent product information such as product name and thumbnail image through the referenced summary type.
variant.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: JOIN e_commerce_mall_product_variants ON cart_items.e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id = variants.id. Returns IECommerceMallProductVariant.ISummary via $ref. Nested join through variant→product (e_commerce_mall_products) provides product name and thumbnail image access.

created_at.description:

Used for sorting cart items (newest first) to present the most recently added items at the top of the cart view.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_cart_items.created_at.

IECommerceMallCartItem.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a single item in the customer's shopping cart, displayed as part of a paginated cart listing.

Each cart item summary represents a customer's intent to purchase a specific quantity of a product variant. It includes the variant information (which provides access to product name, thumbnail image, and option labels through the referenced type), the current unit price, requested quantity, subtotal, and availability status.

Items whose variants have been deleted by the seller or are out of stock are marked as `"unavailable"` and excluded from checkout eligibility. Computed fields: unit_price = COALESCE(variant.price, product.base_price) via JOIN e_commerce_mall_product_variants (variant) → e_commerce_mall_products (product); subtotal = quantity * unit_price; availability = CASE WHEN variant.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(SUM(inventory_records.quantity_change), 0) <= 0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END; stock_warning = (quantity > available_stock); available_stock = COALESCE(SUM(e_commerce_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change), 0). BELONGS-TO relation: variant as $ref to IECommerceMallProductVariant.ISummary (JOIN via e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id, nested join variant→product for product name and thumbnail). Excluded: customer_id and customer resolved from JWT session context; deleted_at filtered in WHERE clause (deleted_at IS NULL); updated_at not essential for summary display; e_commerce_mall_product_variant_id exposed via variant relation object instead of raw scalar.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the order.

Auto-generated UUID assigned at order creation. Used as the primary reference for internal system operations.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_orders.id. UUID primary key.

Human-readable order number assigned at order creation.

Serves as the primary customer-facing identifier used in order confirmation emails, shipment notifications, and customer support interactions. Unique across the entire platform and used as the lookup key in order detail endpoints.
code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_orders.code. Unique across all orders via unique constraint.

Total price of the order, calculated as the sum of all order item subtotals at the time of order creation.

This value is immutable after creation and does not change even if individual items are later cancelled or refunded. It represents the original transaction amount and serves as the authoritative financial record of the purchase.
totalPrice.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_orders.total_price (DoublePrecision). Calculated at order creation as SUM(orderItem.quantity * orderItem.unit_price) across all items. Immutable after creation.

shippingRecipientName.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_orders.shipping_recipient_name. Snapshot-copied from the customer's selected address at checkout — independent of the customer's current address records.

shippingStreetAddress.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from e_commerce_mall_orders.shipping_street_address. Snapshot-copied from the customer's selected address at checkout.
